checks: Revenue CAGR across the last 3 reported financial years: pass >= 15%, caution 5-15%, flag < 5% or falling.
Pass if revenue grew in each of the last 2 years; caution if it fell in an earlier year; flag if it fell in the latest year.
Latest pre-issue debt to equity: pass <= 1, caution > 1 to 2, flag > 2.
Growth of total borrowings vs revenue over the period: pass if borrowings grew slower or fell, caution if within 5 percentage points, flag if borrowings grew faster.
Pass if net worth rose every year, caution if flat in a year, flag if it fell.
Cash flow from operations in the latest full year: pass positive and >= 50% of PAT, caution positive but below 50% of PAT, flag negative.
Latest-year PAT growth: pass >= 15%, caution 0-15%, flag fell or loss-making.
PAT margin over 3 years: pass stable or improving, caution fell by up to 1 percentage point, flag fell by more or loss-making.
Latest ROE / RoNW: pass >= 15%, caution 10-15%, flag < 10%.
EBITDA or PAT margin vs listed-peer median: pass at or above, caution up to 20% below, flag more than 20% below.
Post-issue P/E at the upper band vs peer median P/E: pass at or below, caution up to 25% above, flag more than 25% above.
Price to book vs listed peers
Post-issue price to book vs peer median: pass at or below, caution up to 25% above, flag more than 25% above.
Market cap to sales vs listed peers
Post-issue market cap / latest revenue vs peer median: pass at or below, caution up to 25% above, flag more than 25% above.
Shares issued or transferred in the 12 months before the IPO: pass none or within 20% of the upper band, caution 20-50% below, flag more than 50% below.
Post-issue promoter and promoter group holding: pass >= 51%, caution 35-51%, flag < 35%.
Pass if no pledge of promoter shares is reported, flag if any pledge is reported.
Pass if not material (< 10% of revenue and not called out as a risk), caution 10-25% or called out as a risk, flag > 25%.
Pass if none reported, caution if past actions were settled, flag if SEBI, ED, tax or court actions against promoters or directors are pending.
Offer for sale share of the issue
OFS as % of the total issue: pass <= 25%, caution 25-50%, flag > 50%.
Issue size as % of post-issue market cap: pass >= 20%, caution 10-20%, flag < 10%.
Average acquisition cost of selling shareholders vs the upper band: pass if there is no OFS or the price is under 3x their cost, caution 3-10x, flag above 10x.
Share of the fresh issue for new capex, expansion, R&D or acquisitions: pass >= 40%, caution 20-40%, flag < 20%.
Share of the fresh issue used to repay debt: pass <= 40%, caution 40-70%, flag > 70%.
General corporate purposes as % of gross proceeds: pass <= 15%, caution 15-25%, flag > 25%.
Pass if no proceeds repay loans from promoters or group companies, flag if any do.
Outstanding litigation and claims against the company vs net worth: pass < 10%, caution 10-25%, flag > 25% or any case that threatens operations.
Criminal or regulatory cases against the company, promoters or directors: pass none, caution minor, flag material.
Contingent liabilities vs net worth: pass < 20%, caution 20-50%, flag > 50%.
Revenue from top 10 customers: pass < 50%, caution 50-75% or called out as a key risk without figures, flag > 75% or any single customer > 25%.
Pass if no supplier is above 30% of purchases, caution 30-50%, flag above 50% or a single-supplier dependency called out as a key risk.
Years since the business started: pass >= 10, caution 5-10, flag < 5.
Pass if the audit opinion is clean, caution if there is an emphasis of matter, flag if qualified or the auditor resigned.
